select su.id, su.user_name, su.account_number, su.password, su.sex, su.position, su.whether_block_up, su.update_by, su.update_time, temp.user_name as updateName from sys_user su left join sys_user temp on su.update_by = temp.id where su.del_flag = 0
and ( su.user_name like concat('%',#{nameOrAccount},'%') or su.account_number like concat('%',#{nameOrAccount},'%') )
order by su.update_time desc

select sme.id, sme.parent_id, sme.menu_name, sme.perms_flag, sme.sort_num
,if( (select count(id) from sys_user_menu where user_id = #{userId} and menu_id = sme.id and del_flag = 0 ) > 0, true,false ) as havePerm
from sys_menu sme
left join sys_user_menu sume on sume.menu_id = sme.id
where sme.del_flag = 0
and sume.user_id = #{userId} and sume.del_flag = 0
